question.problem:
What picture is missing from the division model below?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14133144/assets/bb9bf65df4eb34dac86c30479de00123c796c82d3137b69d20a1d21eecae67c3.png)
question.worked_solution:
In the model, we have $\dfrac{4}{6}$ on the left.

Since we need to divide by $\color{blue}2$, we split the whole into $\color{blue}2$ equal parts horizontally. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14133144/assets/84f5fc54aa28636fd587cc712d039bdb984edec3dc3f5f22f891dbc1776fbd3e.png)

From the picture on the right, we obtain that the shaded part represents $\dfrac{4}{12}$ of the whole.

Therefore, the missing picture is the following:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14133144/assets/a68a88f55f3f06c1f238927ae53df6a64348e2ab190673e445568cd1161d46c7.png)
